description:
TOOLS-003: `fits_to_raw` does not check CFITSIO status after reading image parameters or pixels, accepts any non-8-bit FITS image as 16-bit output, and allocates image buffers from unchecked axis multiplication. Bad or unsupported FITS inputs can produce corrupt RAW output or memory faults. Check `status` after every FITS call, explicitly accept only supported `bitpix` values, validate `naxis/naxes`, and verify allocation/write results. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
